concerns.text: The plan states that the bound check (|predicted − actual| < 0.1 for ≥ 95 % of samples) will be performed, but it does not explicitly specify that this evaluation will be on a held‑out test set separate from the data used to train the Kernel Ridge Regression model. Evaluating the bound on the same samples used for training would constitute a circular validation, inflating performance estimates. The plan should add a clear data‑splitting step (e.g., stratified train/validation split) and state that all bound‑verification metrics and the paired t‑test are computed exclusively on the validation portion.
